claims.text: Depression: pervasive boredom or irritability still may be sxs, as can self-injuring behaviors; question directly about suicidal thoughts or attempts if any concern.
claims.quote: Pervasive boredom or irritability still may be symptoms of depression in this age group, as can self-injuring behaviors. It is important to question them directly about suicidal thoughts or attempts if there is any concern about depression or other mental health problems.

claims.text: PTSD: frequently overlooked; can present w sxs of depression and anxiety.
claims.quote: Post-traumatic stress disorder is frequently overlooked and can present with symptoms of depression and anxiety.

claims.text: Transition to adult care: can the y/a explain their medical conditions and meds, allergies, family hx, and emergency care plan; do they know their health insurance coverage and whether they can keep it.
claims.quote: Do you know about your health insurance coverage, and whether you can keep it over the next several years? Can you explain your medical conditions and medications, your allergies, your family history, and your emergency care plan?
